normalize_tensor_to_01: normalize a PyTorch tensor values to the 0-1 range with optional percentile clipping
normalize_vectors_channel_last: normalize PyTorch tensor vectors along the last dimension using L2 norm with epsilon
invert_affine_transform: compute the inverse of a batched 4x4 affine transformation matrix using rotation transpose
invert_3x3_matrix: compute the inverse of a batched 3x3 matrix using the analytical cofactor and determinant method
invert_intrinsic_camera_matrix: compute the inverse of a batched 3x3 camera intrinsic matrix with batched broadcasting
